title: Timing eligibility restores three of four.
summary: The left bend and both chicanes complete. One gain with no losses against the experimental parent; no gains or losses against the retained best. Independent replay admits all 115 returned states.
boundary: The right bend still misses and all-four qualification fails. Source comparison stays closed. One exposed case explains a local repair; useful actual-history intervention and measured response delay remain unestablished.
